Name: Premium Bedroll
Rarity: Common
Description: During downtime\, you automatically clear a Stress.

Name: Potioncraft Kit
Rarity: Common
Description: As an additional downtime move\, you may choose to forage for ingredients that can be used in potioncraft. Roll a d4 and add your Instinct. You collect a number of ingredients equal to the result of this roll. For each collected ingredient\, roll a d6 to determine its properties when used in a potion. Work with the GM to describe these ingredients and add them to your inventory.\n\n1. Heal: Clear 2 Hit Points (2d8 direct physical damage if inverted);\n2. Soothe: Clear 2 Stress;\n3. Empower: You gain a +2 bonus to your next damage roll;\n4. Enhance: You gain a +1 bonus to your next action or reaction roll\n5. Bolster: Double the effectiveness of all ingredients in the potion;\n6. Invert: All ingredient effects become harmful (Mark a Stress or Hit Point instead of clearing it\, receive a -1 penalty to the next Roll instead of a +1 bonus\, etc.);\n\nWhen you take the “Work on a Project” downtime move\, you may create a potion using gathered ingredients. The number of ingredients you can include in a potion equals your Proficiency\, and the project’s Countdown duration is equal to the number of included ingredients. The difficulty is 10 + the number of ingredients.\n\nBy default\, a potion must be ingested to take effect. However\, you may alter the potion for it to activate on contact or disperse as a gas and affect all creatures within Close range of the impact point. If you do so\, double the project’s Countdown.
Excluded From Loot: false

Name: Alchemy Jug

Sloshing sounds can be heard from within the jug when it is shaken\, even if the jug is empty.\n\nOnce per long rest\, You can name one liquid from the table below to cause the jug to produce the chosen liquid. Afterward\, you can uncork the jug as an action and pour that liquid out\, up to 2 gallons per minute. The maximum amount of liquid the jug can produce depends on the liquid you named.\n\nAcidpaste 8 ounces\nBeer 4 gallons\nHoney 1 gallon\nMayonnaise 2 gallons\nOil quart\nVinegar 2 gallons\nWater\, fresh 8 gallons\nWater\, salt 12 gallons\nWine 1 gallon
Excluded From Loot: false

Name: Dancing remains
Rarity: Rare
Description: Throw the remains within Very Close range and make an Agility or Presence Roll (10). On a success\, you make them dance\, giving them a resemblence of life until they take damage or until the end of the scene. When a creature within Very Close range of the remains makes a roll\, spend a Hope to force them to make it with disadvantage\, and forcing them to mark a Stress on a failure. A creature within Very Close range of the remains with all Stress marked starts Dancing\, using their movement to move in a random direction whenever they have the spotlight.
Excluded From Loot: false
